original:
Small isolated events of an unknown 

illness and violence are reported in and 

around Evans City.
translation:
埃文斯城及周边传出零星孤立的

未知疾病与暴力事件，

报道地点在埃文斯城。

original:
News reports of a man dying of an 

unknown illness who was rushed to 

Evans City hospital where bloody 

violence and chaos ensued.
translation:
有报道称一名男子死于一种

未知疾病，他被紧急送往

埃文斯城医院，随后那里爆发了

血腥的暴力与混乱。

original:
More reports of sick, seemingly dead 

people commiting acts of random 

violence in the city. Cannibalism is also 

witnessed but grisly details are being 

withheld to reduce panic.
translation:
更多报道称，患病、看似已死的人

在城市中犯下随机的暴力行为。

还目击到食人行为，但骇人的细节

因过于血腥被压下，

以减少恐慌。

original:
The CDC moves in, setting up 

makeshift zones to try to contain the 

unknown illness. It's reported that bites 

and deep scratches can transfer the 

disease.

The infected victims are clinically dead 

but still move and attack violently, in 

larger and larger numbers.
translation:
疾控中心介入，搭建

临时隔离区，试图控制这种

未知疾病。据报道，咬伤

和深度抓伤都能传播

这种疾病。

被感染者临床已死亡，

却仍会行动并凶猛地攻击，

且数量越来越多。

original:
All news channels are forced off the air. 

Military forces move in and begin a 

quarantine of the entire city. No one is 

permitted to enter or leave the city. 

Military officials broadcast the rules of 

the quarantine: to keep calm and stay 

indoors.

 All outside news channels are reporting 

that there is a chemical leak and that it's 

being cleaned up. The truth of the 

mysterious illness is being withheld from 

the public under government order.
translation:
所有新闻频道被迫停播。

军队进驻并开始

对整座城市实施隔离检疫。

任何人不得进出城市。

军方广播宣布了

隔离规定：保持冷静，

待在家中。

所有外部新闻频道报道称，

这里发生了一起化学品泄漏，

正在被清理。关于这种神秘疾病的

真相，正遵照政府命令

对公众隐瞒。

original:
Riots and panic break out as people try 

to leave the city, hundreds are arrested 

and put into makeshift camps in local 

schools and jails. The military and CDC 

set up quarantine checkpoints 

throughout Evans City to uphold the 

quarantine. Churches and police 

stations are set up to be last minute 

evacuation zones.

 More people become infected and lash 

out violently. Thousands of people are 

being killed. Military open fire on anyone 

approaching checkpoints. The CDC 

begins burning large piles of bodies.
translation:
人们试图逃离城市，暴乱与恐慌爆发，

数百人被捕，被关进当地

学校和监狱改成的临时营地。

军方和疾控中心在整个埃文斯城

设立隔离检查站，

以维持检疫。

教堂和警察局被设为

最后的疏散点。

更多人被感染，

并暴力发作。

数千人丧生。军方对任何

接近检查站的人开火。

疾控中心开始焚烧

成堆的尸体。

original:
The infected walking corpses start to 

outnumber living people in the city. 

Checkpoints are being overrun at a 

faster and faster rate. A central 

command and communications 

checkpoint is overrun by a panicked riot 

of hundreds of civilians followed by a 

horde of undead. A high security 

broadcast radio is stolen in the chaos. 

Communication breaks down 

throughout military channels as the 

military is thrown into disarray.
translation:
被感染的行走尸体数量开始

超过城中的活人。

检查站正以越来越快的速度

被攻陷。一个中央指挥

与通信检查站

被数百名惊慌的平民

发动的暴乱攻陷，

紧随其后的是一大群不死者。

混乱中，一台高安全级别的

广播电台被抢走。

随着军方陷入混乱，

各军事频道之间的通信彻底中断。

original: Abandoned vehicles litter the streets and all throughout Evans City. Some crashed, some destroyed and others abandoned by panicked civilians. There are 3 common sizes; small, medium and large vehicles. The larger the size, the more damage it may cause to your vehicle if you crash into them.These vehicles can be blown up with gun fire and much easier with the rocket launcher, mounted MG or other means of explosions, resulting in chain explosions.
translation: 废弃车辆散落在埃文斯城的街道各处。有些是撞毁的，有些是被摧毁的，还有些是惊慌的平民弃置的。常见尺寸有三种：小型、中型和大型车辆。尺寸越大，撞上去对你的车造成的损伤就越大。这些车辆可以用枪击引爆，用火箭筒、车载机枪或其他爆炸手段则容易得多，还会引发连锁爆炸。

original: Throughout Evans city, there are many large vehicles, left abandoned. From schoolbuses to large military trucks. These vehicles may cause more damage from crashing into them than other vehicle types. Using your SWERVE ability to dodge them can be effective, due to their large size that can take up much of a street.These very large vehicles can be blown up much like other vehicles, with rockets or other explosions, but only chunks of the vehicle at a time.
translation: 埃文斯城内散布着许多被遗弃的大型车辆，从校车到大型军用卡车都有。撞上这类车辆造成的损伤比其他车型更严重。由于它们体积庞大、往往占据大半条街，利用你的急转能力闪避会很有效。这些超大车辆和其他车辆一样可以用火箭或其他爆炸物引爆，但每次只能炸掉一块。

original: Barrels filled with water, can be found on the highway, and in some parts of the city. Used in case a car loses control at high speeds,  will hit the barrels instead of concrete walls.Run over these barrels to spill water onto your engine and extinguishing any fire that may be engulfing it. This will prevent your vehicle from exploding on a further collision.  It will also cool down a smoking engine.
translation: 装满水的桶，可在公路和城市部分地区找到。用于汽车高速失控时，让车撞上水桶而不是混凝土墙。碾过这些水桶，水会洒到你的发动机上，扑灭可能吞噬它的火焰。这能防止你的车在再次碰撞时爆炸。它还能让冒烟的发动机冷却下来。

original: The military are stationed at many checkpoints and locations throughout Evans City to uphold the strict quarantine in hopes to contain the mysterious and deadly epidemic.As the days went by, more control was lost along with military personnel. Their vehicles lay abandoned throughout. Intact vehicles have a small portion of ammunition within them that can be scavenged.
translation: 为维持严格的检疫、遏制这场神秘而致命的疫情，军队驻扎在埃文斯城各处的许多检查站和地点。随着日子过去，军队人员和掌控力不断流失，他们的车辆被弃置各处。完好的车辆里有一些可以搜刮的弹药。

original: Fire Hydrants can be found throughout Evans City.  The highway and parks, however, do not have fire hydrants.Shooting a fire hydrant enough will destroy it, resulting in a geyser of water to explode into the air. This water geyser can then put out any fires your vehicle may have by simply driving through it.  It will also cool down a smoking engine.Driving over a fully intact fire hydrant won't have the same effect because the water geyser is delayed.
translation: 埃文斯城各处都能找到消防栓。不过公路和公园没有消防栓。用枪把消防栓打坏，它会爆裂，水柱冲天而起。只要开车穿过这道水柱，就能扑灭车辆上的火。它还能让冒烟的发动机冷却。直接从完好的消防栓上碾过去不会有同样效果，因为水柱会延迟喷出。

original: Apache Helicopters can sometimes fly to your location and aid you for a limited amount of time. These helicopters will hover in front and above your own vehicle and match your speed and direction with a slight delay.They come armed with heavy machinegun turrets and rockets and will shoot up a path for you.In all the challenge modes except Rescue Op and F.U.B.A.R., they will be available every time a certain distance is reached and can be called in when you desire.  Upgrading the Chopper Support will make it available more frequently and will help you for a longer time.
translation: 阿帕奇直升机有时会飞到你的位置，在有限时间内协助你。这些直升机会悬停在你车辆的前上方，略带延迟地匹配你的速度和方向。它们装备重机枪塔和火箭，会为你扫清前路。除救援行动和 F.U.B.A.R. 外的所有挑战模式中，每当你达到一定距离它们就会出现，可随时呼叫。升级直升机支援可以让它出现得更频繁，协助你更久。

original: In the F.U.B.A.R. challenge mode, Apache Helicopters will occasionally show up to try to wreck your day. They will fly in front and above your vehicle, following your direction with a slight delay. They use the same weapons as support choppers.  However, they will wait for orders to fire their rockets.They have a large amount of health, but can be taken out with gun fire and rather quickly with rockets and by making it fly 3 times into highway signs.
translation: 在 F.U.B.A.R. 挑战模式中，阿帕奇直升机会偶尔出现找你的麻烦。它们会飞到你的车辆前上方，略带延迟地跟随你的方向。它们使用与支援直升机相同的武器。不过，它们会等待命令才发射火箭。它们血量很高，但可以用枪击消灭，用火箭则相当快，还可以让它 3 次撞上公路标牌。

original: Car repair garages can be found in many parts of Evans City. These buildings were places of business by mechanics, to repair customers cars. Now abandoned, these places contain many spare tires, repair equipment and extra parts for bumper fortification for your own vehicle at the cost of RP.
translation: 埃文斯城许多地方都有汽车修理厂。这些建筑原本是技师修理顾客车辆的经营场所。如今已废弃，里面有大量备用轮胎、维修设备，以及用于加固你车辆保险杠的额外零件，花费 RP 即可使用。

original: Police stations can be found throughout Evans City. During the  initial quarantine, the military designated police stations as a location for chopper rescue points for evacuating uninfected civilians and personnel. This was soon scrapped as the quarantine was fully enforced, favoring to try to keep the epidemic contained. These locations still have fortified doors and food rations within. Weapons and weapon upgrades can be purchased with RP in police stations.Rescued civilians can be dropped off at these locations for RP bonuses as well.
translation: 埃文斯城各处都有警察局。在最初的隔离期间，军方将警察局指定为直升机救援点，用来撤离未感染的平民和人员。但随着隔离全面执行，这一做法很快被取消，转而试图把疫情控制在城内。这些地点仍有加固的门和食物补给。在警察局可以用 RP 购买武器和武器升级。把获救的平民送到这些地点也能获得 RP 奖励。

original: As order has broken down and the quarantine has failed, many civilians have panicked and broken out of their designated zones, using their own vehicles.When driving through intersections, be watchful of these incoming cars, they can come from the right or left side, usually blaring their horn at you.
translation: 随着秩序崩溃、隔离失败，许多平民惊慌失措，开着自家的车冲出指定区域。驶过路口时要当心这些来车，它们可能从右侧或左侧冲出，通常还冲你狂按喇叭。

original: Churches can be found throughout Evans City. During the  initial quarantine, the military designated churches as chopper rescue points for evacuating uninfected civilians and personnel. This was soon scrapped as the quarantine was fully enforced, favoring to try to keep the epidemic contained. These locations still have fortified doors and food rations within.Rescued civilians can be dropped off at these locations for RP bonuses.Medical shots can also be purchased for RP at churches.
translation: 埃文斯城各处都有教堂。在最初的隔离期间，军方将教堂指定为直升机救援点，用来撤离未感染的平民和人员。但随着隔离全面执行，这一做法很快被取消，转而试图把疫情控制在城内。这些地点仍有加固的门和食物补给。把获救的平民送到这些地点可以获得 RP 奖励。在教堂还可以用 RP 购买医疗针剂。

original: Weapon caches can be found in every part of Evans City, left behind by military personnel. These caches contain new weapons , vehicle weapon attachments and full ammo replenishments. Note that weapon caches are the only locations with vehicle turret attachments .Individual weapon and weapon upgrades can also be obtained, all at the cost of RP.
translation: 埃文斯城各处都能找到军方人员留下的武器补给点。这些补给点里有新武器、车载武器配件和全额弹药补给。注意，武器补给点是唯一提供车载炮塔配件的地方。也可以获取单件武器和武器升级，全部花费 RP。

original: Many fuel trucks have been abandoned in various places in Evans City. There can be a lot of them in industrial sections especially. These vehicles carry volatile fuel that can be ignited, causing a huge explosion with just a few shots from any weapon or nearby explosions. The large area of effect of its explosion can take out many other objects and vehicles, causing chain reactions. Crashing into one of these trucks can be fatal.
translation: 许多油罐车被遗弃在埃文斯市的各个地方，尤其在工业区数量最多。这些车辆运载着极易燃的燃料，任何武器几枪或附近的爆炸就能将其引爆，造成巨大爆炸。爆炸范围很大，能摧毁许多其他物体和车辆，引发连锁反应。撞上这类油罐车可能是致命的。

original: Explosive mines have been left behind by the bomb squads of the military in various locations. They were used to maintain quarantine and to destroy large groups of the undead to prevent them from reaching checkpoints. They can be spotted by their loud beeping noise and blinking red light. These mines are motion sensitive and can tell when a moving object is near, giving off faster warning beeps.They can be blown up with any gunfire or other nearby explosions. Running over them or being too close when they go off can cause damage to you and your vehicle.
translation: 军方的排爆小队在各个地点遗留了爆炸性地雷。它们被用来维持隔离，摧毁大群丧尸，阻止它们抵达检查站。可以通过它们响亮的蜂鸣声和闪烁的红灯发现它们。这些地雷对移动敏感，能察觉附近有移动物体，并加快发出警告蜂鸣。任何枪击或附近的爆炸都能将其引爆。碾过它们或在它们引爆时靠得太近，都会对你和你的车辆造成伤害。

original: Oil spills are on the streets, leaking from vehicles and other debris. Driving over an oil spill will cause your vehicle to slip out of control for a short period of time. Use your SWERVE ability to dodge them easier.
translation: 街上散布着漏油，来自车辆和其他残骸的泄漏。驶过漏油会让你的车辆短暂失控打滑。使用你的 SWERVE 能力可以更容易地闪避它们。

original: After the failed containment of the epidemic, most of Evans city's population has perished, either from the infected undead, military interventions or even suicide and panicked vehicular homicide. Littering the streets are many corpses or what's left of them after being devoured by the undead.  Running over these corpses will temporarily slow your vehicle down.
translation: 疫情控制失败后，埃文斯市的大部分人口已经死亡，有的死于被感染的丧尸，有的死于军方干预，甚至有人自杀或在恐慌中驾车撞人。街上到处是尸体，或是被丧尸啃食后剩下的残骸。碾过这些尸体会让你的车辆暂时减速。

original: The military and police have deployed numerous spike strips on roads and highways around Evans City to enforce the quarantine. Civilians trying to escape in their vehicle don't get very far when they run over one of these, causing all their tires to go flat.You can use your SWERVE ability to dodge these traps, explosions and rockets to blow them up and upgraded tires to resist them better.
translation: 军方和警方在埃文斯市周边的道路和高速公路上布设了大量钉刺带，以强制执行隔离。试图驾车逃离的平民一旦碾上，所有轮胎都会爆胎，跑不了多远。你可以使用 SWERVE 能力闪避这些陷阱，用爆炸和火箭弹将其炸毁，或升级轮胎以更好地抵御它们。

original: Near the final days and hours, the military, in full panic, issued the use of aircraft to bomb large parts of Evans City.  In this vain attempt to stop the undead plague from spreading, many innocent civilians were caught in these jets bombings while trying to escape the city or simply by being held up in buildings in the bombings' path. During the breakdown of communications, the jets are known to accidentally bomb other military personnel who happen to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. The jets can only bomb in a straight line so SWERVE out of the bombing lane or stay out of that lane if you see a jet flying over it. Their bombs can cause chain reaction explosions, so be aware of your surroundings.
translation: 在最后的日子里，军方陷入极度恐慌，下令出动飞机轰炸埃文斯市的大片区域。这种阻止丧尸瘟疫蔓延的徒劳尝试中，许多无辜平民在试图逃离城市时被这些轰炸机波及，或仅仅因为被困在轰炸路径上的建筑里而遭殃。通信中断期间，这些飞机会误炸恰好在错误时间身处错误地点的其他军人。飞机只能沿直线轰炸，所以看到飞机从某条线路上方飞过时，就 SWERVE 离开轰炸带或待在带外。它们的炸弹会引发连锁爆炸，注意观察四周。

original: Military security checkpoint fences can be found at quarantine checkpoints along streets and highways. They can also be found in alleyways, in failed attempts to wall off the undead hordes.Running over these fences does small to no damage to your vehicle.When shooting at targets behind a fence, there is a small chance the bullets will strike the fence itself instead of the target.
translation: 在街道和高速公路旁的隔离检查站可以见到军方的安全检查站围栏。它们也出现在小巷里，是试图隔绝丧尸群的失败尝试。碾过这些围栏对你的车辆几乎或完全不会造成损伤。向围栏后的目标射击时，子弹有小概率会打在围栏本身而不是目标上。

original: The people of Evans City have been infected by an unknown, mysterious plague.Thousands are dying by the hour and the weeks long quarantine by the military to contain it has broken down into chaos completely.These common undead are the recently dead, reanimated and roaming the city, murdering anyone in their path and feasting on their flesh.Acting on pure instinct, they seem to lack any intelligent thought and can't be reasoned with. The rate of decay has slowed down or stopped completely shortly after reanimation. They are able to take more punishment than a normal living person could ever take. The only way to destroy them is to completely destroy the brain or completely bodily dismember them.These are the weakest but most common of the undead.
translation: 埃文斯市的居民被一种未知而神秘的瘟疫感染。每时每刻都有成千上万人死去，军方为控制疫情而实施的数周隔离已彻底陷入混乱。这些普通丧尸是刚死去不久的人，重新苏醒后在城中游荡，杀害沿途的任何人并吞食其血肉。它们全凭本能行动，似乎没有任何思考能力，也无法讲理。丧尸化后不久，腐烂速度便会减慢或完全停止。它们能承受比正常活人多得多的伤害。要消灭它们，唯一的方法是彻底摧毁大脑，或将其身体完全肢解。它们是丧尸中最弱但最常见的一种。

original: The undead have an insatiable appetite, devouring everyone they can reach. Usually they will eat a small portion of a victim and then lose interest as the meat turns cold and starts to reanimate into another undead. Sometimes however, they enter into a feeding frenzy, stuffing themselves with as much of a body as they can fit inside their stomach, often causing their internal organs to burst and leak whatever they are eating back onto the ground.Common and ravager undead can often be seen in a feeding frenzy. They will ignore other living people around them, unless shot at or provoked, then they will stand up and come after you. Running over a feeder will grind lots of gore into your wheels, temporarily slowing you down quite a lot.
translation: 丧尸有着永不满足的食欲，见到够得着的人就吞食。通常它们会吃掉受害者的一小部分，随后肉变冷并开始变异成另一只丧尸，它们便失去兴趣。但有时它们会陷入疯狂进食，尽量把尸体塞进胃里，常常撑破内脏，把正在吃的东西漏回地面。普通丧尸和噬尸者常常会陷入疯狂进食。它们会无视周围其他活人，除非遭到射击或挑衅，才会站起来追你。碾过一个暴食者会把大量血肉绞进车轮，让你暂时大幅减速。

original: Ravagers, a slightly less common undead type, its name coined by some military personnel for being 'ravaged', half eaten and rotten looking. These undead have slightly mutated and suffer horrible wounds from being eaten when they were killed originally.They tend to be slightly stronger than common undead and are able to take more punishment before being destroyed.
translation: 噬尸者是较为少见的丧尸类型，这个名字是一些军人起的，因为它们看上去被啃食过一半、腐烂不堪。这些丧尸发生了轻微变异，身上带着最初被杀死时被啃咬留下的可怕伤口。它们通常比普通丧尸稍强，被消灭前能承受更多伤害。

original: The Brutes are zombies that were large physically fit individuals in life. The plague seemed to amplify these particular infected's testosterone and adrenalin levels, making them slightly faster and tougher than common undead and ravagers. They also show signs of slight mutation and some believe they are the infected types that eventually transform into rampaging mutants but no one is sure.These undead are some of the toughest to take down, being stronger than both common undead and ravagers and requiring a little more firepower to take down.
translation: 壮尸生前是体格健壮的大块头。瘟疫似乎放大了这类感染者体内的睾酮和肾上腺素水平，使它们比普通丧尸和噬尸者更快、更耐打。它们也显示出轻微变异的迹象，有人认为它们最终会转变为狂暴的变异体，但没人确定。这些丧尸是最难消灭的种类之一，比普通丧尸和噬尸者都更强，需要更强的火力才能干掉。

original: Military personnel that have been killed trying to keep the quarantine upheld in Evans City.  They can be seen all around the city, but more concentrated in overrun checkpoints.They are on par with Brutes in toughness and speed but they still wear their military gear and armor, providing more protection. Their helmet and body armor has a small chance to cause bullets to ricochet off them, dealing zero damage.
translation: 这些是试图维持埃文斯市隔离时被杀的军人。城中到处都能见到它们，在被攻陷的检查站里尤为集中。它们的耐打程度和速度与壮尸相当，但仍然穿着军装和护甲，因此防护更好。它们的头盔和防弹衣有小概率使子弹弹开，造成零伤害。

original: Grubs, their name coined due to their moist and see through skin, are types of undead that lie in wait among the many dead. These victims took much longer to reanimate than all the others, sometimes rotting and bloating in the streets or body piles for days before the virus took over and reanimated them.  Stinking, rotting and suffering from the early stages of putrification, these rancid horrors are able to spread the plague much faster with its sloshing bodily fluids constantly oozing and falling off of their bodies.After they fully renanimate, the putrification and rotting halts like the other types of undead but the damage is done already. They will typically lay motionless, waiting for a victim to walk within grasping distance. Driving directly over a grub corpse will automatically result in a hood grapple, so keep your eyes peeled for them.  They are slightly tougher than ravagers but weaker than brutes.
translation: 蛆尸因皮肤湿滑透明而得名，是潜伏在众多死者之间的一种丧尸。这些受害者的苏醒时间比所有其他丧尸都长得多，有时在街上或尸堆里腐烂膨胀好几天，病毒才接管并令其苏醒。这些恶臭的恐怖之物散发着臭味、正在腐烂、处于腐败初期，它们不断渗出并掉落的黏滑体液能让瘟疫传播得更快。完全苏醒后，腐败和腐烂会像其他丧尸一样停止，但伤害早已造成。它们通常一动不动地躺着，等待受害者走进伸手可及的范围内。直接碾过一具蛆尸会立即引发引擎盖缠斗，所以要留意它们。它们比噬尸者稍耐打，但比壮尸弱。

original: It's unknown how much the virus can alter the human body but these types of undead are the most dangerous by far. The infected body's bones have mutated and enlarged until they burst from the skin, somtimes in large shards. The muscle tissue has expanded, making a single mutant as strong as several men. It's not known what happened to their skin but some military personnel claimed they witnessed one rip its own skin off and devour it, in a raged frenzy, before it tore down a barricade. These undead seem to be hyped up on adrenalin and rage and with the addition of enhanced strength, they leave little time to deal with them before they devastate entire checkpoints, bases and fortifications within minutes.These types of infected are much tougher and can take much more damage than any other types of undead. They can outrun vehicles, power-slam onto hoods and reach through side windows and pull drivers out onto the street.
translation: 目前尚不清楚病毒能在多大程度上改变人体，但这类丧尸是目前为止最危险的。感染者的骨骼发生变异并不断增大，直到刺破皮肤，有时是巨大的骨刺。肌肉组织膨胀，使一个变异体的力量堪比数人。它们的皮肤发生了什么无人知晓，但一些军人声称目睹过一个变异体在狂怒中将自身的皮肤撕下吞食，随后拆毁了一座路障。这些丧尸似乎被肾上腺素和愤怒冲昏了头，再加上增强的力量，它们能在几分钟内摧毁整个检查站、基地和防御工事，让人几乎没有时间应对。这类感染者比任何其他丧尸都更强壮，能承受更多伤害。它们能跑过车辆，猛扑砸上引擎盖，还能从侧窗伸手把驾驶员拽到街上。

original: The few civilians remaining alive in Evans City are in a last desperate attempt to escape the plague after the military quarantine failed and power structures fell apart.Many tried to leave in their cars  but were blocked at gunpoint on the highways and streets by military personnel. During the final chaos, many abandoned their cars, trapped in traffic and panic, to escape the oncoming hordes of undead, running anywhere they could, but most often to their death.Civilians can be rescued by stopping your vehicle and honking your horn at them. They will then run to you and get inside if you don't have any zombie on your hood. Your Vehicle can hold up to 5 civilians at a time. While driving on the road, you can honk your horn to make civilians run out of the way in hopes not to hit them. Dropping them off at police stations and churches can grant bonus RP. Accidently killing a civilian will result in a RP penalty!
translation: 军方隔离失败、权力体系崩溃后，埃文斯市仅存的少数平民在做最后的绝望挣扎，试图逃离瘟疫。许多人想开车离开，却在高速公路和街道上被军方持枪拦下。在最后的混乱中，许多人困在车流和恐慌里，弃车逃生，躲避涌来的丧尸群，四处奔逃，但多半是奔向死亡。只要停下车并按喇叭，就能救助平民。若你的引擎盖上没有丧尸，他们就会跑过来上车。你的车辆一次最多可载 5 名平民。在路上行驶时，你可以按喇叭让平民闪开，以免撞到他们。把他们送到警察局和教堂可获得额外 RP。意外撞死平民会导致 RP 惩罚！

original: In the F.U.B.A.R. challenge mode, you will have to fight enemy soldiers.They will fire fully automatic rifles at you with progressive aiming.If you're not in their lane, they will continue to fire and gradually correct their aim. There are 3 standard soldier behaviors: stationary, alignment and hidden.Hidden soldiers will pop out from behind cars and blast you.Fire at soldiers to kill them, obviously, but also to suppress their position and make them find another firing position.\Soldiers are normal humans and can be killed with a few gun shots but their body armor has a small chance to block bullets as well.
translation: 在 F.U.B.A.R. 挑战模式中，你必须与敌方士兵交战。他们会用全自动步枪射击你，并逐步修正瞄准。如果你不在他们的射击线上，他们会持续开火并逐渐校正准星。士兵有 3 种标准行为：驻守、横向移动和隐藏。隐藏的士兵会从车后窜出向你开火。向士兵开火既能杀死他们，也能压制其位置，迫使他们另寻射击点。\士兵是普通人，几枪就能打死，但他们的防弹衣也有小概率挡下子弹。

original: In the F.U.B.A.R. challenge mode, some soldiers will control spike strips and pull the spike strip toward them to try to rip your tires. You can attempt to fake them out by swerving out of the way while driving to the empty space where they would eventually pull the spikes to.
translation: 在 F.U.B.A.R. 挑战模式中，有些士兵会操作钉刺带，把钉刺带拉向自己，试图扎破你的轮胎。你可以试着虚晃一招：驾驶时拐向一旁，驶入他们最终会把钉刺拉向的空当。

original: In the F.U.B.A.R. challenge mode, bomb squads will lie in wait with their line of remote controlled bombs ready to go off. When you get close enough to them, they will set them off.  The bombs can blow from left to right or from right to left so pay attention.  Swerving toward the starting point of the explosions is usually the best way to dodge the line of bombs.
translation: 在 F.U.B.A.R. 挑战模式中，排爆小队会埋伏起来，摆好一排遥控炸弹随时引爆。等你靠得足够近，他们就会引爆。炸弹可能从左往右炸，也可能从右往左，所以要注意。朝爆炸起始点打方向，通常是躲避这排炸弹的最佳方法。

original: Mounted weapons can only be purchased with RP at Weapon Caches.You can only have one type of weapon installed at a time.There are 2 types, the mounted machinegun and the rocket launcher.Both weapons can cause cars to blow up, although the mounted machinegun takes a few shots while the rocket launcher only requires 1 direct hit.Rocket explosions have a large area of damage that can also cause chain reaction explosions. Rockets can also easily blast through other obstacles such as barricades, trees and very large vehicles.Ammunition for these mounted weapons cannot be replenished and therefore need to be repurchased when they run out of ammo.
translation: 车载武器只能在武器库用 RP 购买。同一时间只能安装一种武器。共有 2 种：车载机枪和火箭发射器。两种武器都能把车炸毁，不过车载机枪需要几发，而火箭发射器只需 1 发直接命中。火箭爆炸杀伤范围大，还能引发连锁爆炸。火箭也能轻易炸穿路障、树木和大型车辆等其他障碍物。这些车载武器的弹药无法补充，因此打光后需要重新购买。

original: Diane has 4 personal weapons she can acquire. She will start with the Pistol and Shotgun and can purchase the last 2 weapons at a Weapon Cache or Police Station for RP. She can also upgrade each weapon's Damage, Accuracy and Bullet Capacity.Gun Aiming, Handling and Reloading will also gradually level up as you use them.
translation: 黛安可以获取 4 种个人武器。她初始拥有手枪和霰弹枪，另外 2 种可以在武器库或警察局用 RP 购买。她还能升级每种武器的伤害、精准度和弹容量。枪械瞄准、操控和装弹也会随着使用逐渐升级。

original: Cocheta has 4 personal weapons he can acquire. He will start with the Pistol and Assault SMG and can purchase the last 2 weapons at a Weapon Cache or Police Station for RP. He can also upgrade each weapon's Damage, Accuracy and Bullet Capacity.Gun Aiming, Handling and Reloading will also gradually level up as you use them.
translation: 科切塔可以获取 4 种个人武器。他初始拥有手枪和突击冲锋枪，另外 2 种可以在武器库或警察局用 RP 购买。他还能升级每种武器的伤害、精准度和弹容量。枪械瞄准、操控和装弹也会随着使用逐渐升级。

original: Both Diane and Cocheta can level up individual skills as they use them.The more each character drives, the better they will get at it.They will also get better Toughness as they survive impacts and explosions, making them better suited to handle collisions, explosions and mutant side grapples.
translation: 黛安和科切塔都能在使用中提升各自的技能。角色开车越多，驾驶技术就越好。他们在承受撞击和爆炸后还会提升韧性，从而更能应对碰撞、爆炸和变异体的侧面缠斗。

original: Perks can be purchased at location stops with RP.Each Perk, once purchased, grants a permanent ability, although the chopper assist Perk will not work in the story mode nor in the Rescue Op and F.U.B.A.R. challenge modes.Each perk works for both Diane and Cocheta with 5 tiers to make them more powerful.
translation: 特长可以在沿途站点用 RP 购买。每个特长一旦购买，就会提供一项永久能力，不过直升机支援特长在剧情模式以及救援行动和 F.U.B.A.R. 挑战模式中无效。每个特长对黛安和科切塔都生效，共有 5 个等级，可让它们更强。

original: Medical shots can be purchased with RP at Churches. You can purchase the shots up to 5 times each.The steroid shot will grant both characters a temporary personal resistance to damage, allowing them to go through explosions unscathed.Med Patch shots are a cocktail of many things that will alleviate your characters' suffering (indictated by the screen flashing red) and restore their health.
translation: 医疗针剂可以在教堂用 RP 购买。每种针剂最多可购买 5 次。类固醇针剂会让两个角色暂时获得个人伤害抗性，能安然穿过爆炸。医疗包针剂是多种成分的混合剂，能缓解角色的痛苦（屏幕闪红即表示处于痛苦中）并恢复生命值。

original: Alpha Mutants are an off-shoot of the typical mutants seen rampaging the streets of Evans City.They have a distinctly darker skull color and exhibit greater speed, strength and hostility.They were coined 'Alphas' not just because they are more dangerous but because there is never more than one seen together and is usually followed around by several regular mutants, acting almost as a pack, hunting and destroying everything in their paths.Alphas will often go into a rage and bash the hood of your car, damaging your engine and disrupting your aim temporarily.
translation: 阿尔法变异体是埃文斯市街头肆虐的普通变异体的一个分支。它们的头骨颜色明显更深，速度、力量和攻击性都更强。它们被称为「阿尔法」，不仅因为更危险，还因为从不会同时出现两只，而且通常有几只普通变异体跟随左右，几乎像一群野兽，猎杀并摧毁沿途的一切。阿尔法变异体常常会暴怒，猛砸你汽车的引擎盖，损坏引擎并暂时干扰你的瞄准。

original: 1. Extreme speed: Mutants can leap long distances and over obstacles.2. Power-Slam: A mutant can leap and slam onto the hood, causing massive shaking.3. Mutants have the highest Health after Alpha mutants.4: They will run along side your vehicle, sometimes in front, attacking randomly. They will leap off the hood if they take too much damage but will continue to chase you.5: They can side grapple you through your side window, grabbing hold of the driver or gunner. The driver can mash the interact (space) key to break out of it, like wise the gunner can mash the fire button (mouse) to win the struggle. If the Driver is side grappled, the gunner can also shoot the grappling mutant in the head to kill it, ending the grapple. If the gunner is side grappled, the driver can grind the side walls in alleyways and on highways, to grind the mutant off, ending the grapple.
translation: 1. 极速：变异体能远距离跳跃并越过障碍物。2. 猛扑：变异体能跃起砸上引擎盖，造成剧烈震动。3. 变异体的生命值仅次于阿尔法变异体。4. 它们会跑在你车辆旁边，有时在前方，随机发动攻击。受到太多伤害时它们会跳下引擎盖，但仍会继续追赶你。5. 它们能从侧窗发动侧面缠斗，抓住驾驶员或枪手。驾驶员可以猛按互动（空格）键挣脱，枪手同样可以猛按开火（鼠标）键赢得挣扎。如果驾驶员被侧面缠斗，枪手还能射击缠斗中的变异体头部将其击杀，结束缠斗。如果枪手被侧面缠斗，驾驶员可以把车蹭向小巷和高速公路的侧墙，将变异体磨掉，结束缠斗。

original: The alpha mutant uses the same tactics as the regular mutants but does so in an even more brutal way.  It's stronger, faster and tougher. When an alpha mutant is on your hood, they will sometimes go into a frenzy, slamming the hood, causing damage and shaking the vehicle, ruining your aim.There is never 2 alpha mutants together but a single alpha will usually have a small group of regular mutants following it around, like a pack.
translation: 阿尔法变异体采用与普通变异体相同的战术，但方式更加凶残。它更强、更快、更耐打。当阿尔法变异体趴在你的引擎盖上时，它有时会陷入狂暴，猛砸引擎盖，造成损伤并震动车辆，扰乱你的瞄准。从不会同时出现 2 只阿尔法变异体，但单独一只通常带着一小群普通变异体，像一伙兽群。

original: 1. Headshots are the most effective method of killing. The head must be completely  destroyed, so several shots are usually required.2. Can be gibbed by shooting areas besides the head with enough shots and with powerful weapons.3. All zombie types will try to cling onto your vehicle's hood, the faster you are going the less likely they will succeed and instead be destroyed by your bumper.4. Once on your hood, you have a limited time to either kill or remove the zombie before it will kill you. Shooting its arms off will make it easier to knock it off, but it can still kill you. Blowing off its arms will reset its kill timer.5.  Zombies will appear more often as you progress and will come from behind cars and buildings. 6. Swerving into a rail or side wall a few times can knock off a hood clinger without damaging your vehicle or wasting any ammo.
translation: 1. 爆头是最有效的击杀方法。头部必须被彻底摧毁，因此通常需要好几枪。2. 用强力武器朝头部以外的部位射击足够多次，也能将丧尸打成碎块。3. 所有类型的丧尸都会试图攀上你车辆的引擎盖，车速越快它们越难成功，反而会被保险杠撞碎。4. 一旦丧尸上了引擎盖，你在被它杀死前只有有限时间将其击杀或甩掉。打断它的手臂会更容易把它甩下去，但它仍能杀死你。炸掉它的双臂会重置它的击杀倒计时。5. 随着游戏推进，丧尸出现得更频繁，并从汽车和建筑后面冒出来。6. 朝护栏或侧墙蹭几次，就能甩掉扒在引擎盖上的丧尸，既不会损坏车辆，也不浪费弹药。

original: These mines are similar to the normal mines except they emit a green light instead of a red one. They will be lined up across the street and explode similarly to Bomb Squads when you get too close to them in your vehicle.Swerving slightly towards the start of the chain explosion can help dodge it. They can also be blown up by gun fire.
